description: This Java class 'CloseEmailCampaignCommandHandler' handles the command to close an email campaign within the Fineract system. It implements the 'NewCommandSourceHandler' interface and delegates the close operation to 'EmailCampaignWritePlatformService'.

classes.name: CloseEmailCampaignCommandHandler
classes.description: A Spring service class that handles the command to close an email campaign by invoking the appropriate method in the email campaign service.

methods.name: CloseEmailCampaignCommandHandler
methods.description: Constructor that injects the email campaign write platform service dependency.

methods.name: processCommand
methods.description: Processes the command to close an email campaign by calling 'closeEmailCampaign' on the service with the entity id and command.
